Hey all — dropping the technical runbook excerpts here so your SREs can validate. Full runbook attached: redwood-scim-runbook.md

SAML handshake checklist (excerpt):
1) Exchange metadata URLs (we will import your IdP metadata and give you our SP metadata).
2) Validate EntityID / ACS endpoints: our SP entity: https://privcp.acme.redwood.ai/saml/consume
3) Upload primary and secondary certs (PEM). Secondary cert will be used for a 7-day overlap window during rotation.
4) Test sign-in against a canary user (we recommend a non-admin test account) and confirm SAML attributes: email, eduPersonPrincipalName, groups.

Cert rotation sequence (ops-safe):
- Step 0: Pre-cutover backup of SP metadata and current certs (Redwood and Acme)
- Step 1: Upload new cert as secondary in Okta and mark as staged
- Step 2: Configure Redwood to accept the secondary cert and wait 1 hour for propagation in our Private CP devices
- Step 3: Execute live canary sign-in; if successful for 30 minutes, promote new cert to primary at time T
- Step 4: Remove old cert after 7 days of stable operation

SCIM provisioning notes:
- We support /Users and /Groups endpoints, incremental deltas using change tokens, and group filters by attribute (we'll need the exact path for department).
- The SCIM service account requires these scopes: scim:read, scim:write, scim:groups. We will provide an example IAM policy snippet.

Rollback plan: If SAML login fails post-promotion, we automatically revert to old cert within 5 minutes and notify both teams.

Next: can you confirm Aaron Li will run the canary and that you will reach out to me on Slack when you initiate Step 2?

—Dev
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
